body:
WHAT THE CODE SHOWS BEYOND THE REGISTER (app/lib read 6 Nov 2026, main 068c71a; not run). The target design stays B-17's second row in docs/tasks/AUDIT-BUILT-2026-11-05.md; this is the checklist and the traps.

SIZE OF THE JOB, measured (uses/files in app/lib): serverReachableProvider 9/4, isKnownUnreachable 2/2, phoneOnlineProvider 7/6, canReachServerNow 2/1, connectivityProvider 2/2, connectionProblemProvider 8/3, connectionStripProvider 3/2, networkKindProvider 31/15 (a raw fact, stays), phoneHasInternetProvider 5/3, networkValidationProvider 2/2 (raw, stays), serverAwayProvider 5/3, instantAvailableProvider 14/9, requestPortalOfferedProvider 8/4, `.encoreMode` 15/13. Definitions: app/connection.dart, app/providers.dart:158-190, app/playback_providers.dart:48, features/common/playability.dart:13, features/instant/instant_controller.dart:181-189. Small enough to do in one pass.

TRAPS
 1. A raw fact depends on the presentation. `phoneHasInternetProvider` (connection.dart:55-59) watches `connectionProblemProvider`, so Android's internet check is re-asked only after the strip's 4 s grace. The new state must ask Android from raw network changes only; the strip stays a presenter on top (its three timers: 4 s grace in ConnectionProblemNotifier, 5 s shown and 10 s recovered in ConnectionStripNotifier).
 2. A dead feature sits in the core. `ConnectionProblem.jamReconnecting` and the import of features/jam/jam_providers.dart (connection.dart:5,27,86,130-131) make reachability depend on the Jam, whose hub the product does not run (B-20). Take it out of the enum; the Jam shows its own state.
 3. The player takes the notion four times (app/playback_providers.dart:155-176): `canReachServer`, `networkPresent`, `internetFound`, `serverAnswers`, plus two listeners that call `engine.networkChanged` (networkKind and serverReachable, ~188-200) and the engine's own retry timers (`_scheduleServerRetry`, playback_engine.dart:947, up to 10 minutes). Give the engine one read of the derived state and one `recheck()`; keep its song-versus-server judging (`_judgeFailure`, docs/33 G-1): that decides whether a song is broken, which is a different question.
 4. `session.encoreMode` (15 uses), `instantAvailableProvider` and `requestPortalOfferedProvider` become one `serverKindProvider`; the portal one disappears with P2-07.

B-58 IS IN THIS ITEM'S ACCEPTANCE and needs the state: the outbox must deliver when the derived state goes serverAway -> ok. Today a delivery starts only from `onQueued` (outbox.dart:554,588) or a sync run, and the backoff (outbox.dart:212) has no timer of its own. Subscribe the outbox to the state's transitions and schedule a wake at the earliest `nextAttemptAtMs`.

TESTS THAT MUST STAY GREEN: test/app/can_reach_server_test.dart, test/app/connection_test.dart (18), test/features/connection_banner_test.dart, offline_look_test.dart, settings/play_status_refresh_test.dart, now_playing_layout_test.dart. Docs to change in the same PR: docs/31 (the states table), docs/33 G-1, AUDIT B-17 (mark closed).
